offering_description.value: Develops test, monitoring, assurance, and resilient positioning, navigation and timing tools for communications networks, data centers and other critical infrastructure. It also develops coatings, filters and other optical technologies for high-volume applications in anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, aerospace, industrial and automotive markets.

quotes.quote: Our test, monitoring, assurance, and resilient position, navigation and timing solutions enable and secure critical infrastructure ranging from data center ecosystems and communication networks to military, aerospace, railway and first responder communications. In addition, we develop and advance technologies used in high-volume optical applications across anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, aerospace, industrial and automotive end markets.

From testing, assuring, and securing the largest communications networks around the globe, to the coatings and filters that make your car’s spatial sensing possible, our technologies have a diverse impact on the world. Discover how we enable new possibilities that touch every area of life.
